title: Doctoral / PhD Programs | KPGU
content: to enhance their research acumen and qualifications KPGU is offering a recognized Ph.D programme in varied subjects that cover Engineering and Technology, Pharmaceutical sciences and basic Sciences. The research scholar at KPGU is offered the right research milieu to equip him/her with the skills necessary to make a high impact on research and development in various fields. The research may range from pure to applied and conceptual.
